scope: Blackbeard’s Castle, the Skytsborg watchtower on Government Hill, in its early twentieth-century appearance around the 1918 postcard. Includes the tapered rubble-masonry tower, north entry and historical wooden observatory on the parapet.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The NPS Skytsborg designation measures a 20-foot base, a 17-foot-8-inch parapet diameter and a 31-foot-6-inch masonry height. It describes the north arched door, four rows of gun ports and the historical wooden observatory visible on the postcards.
